Every case states WHY it exists — a case whose reason is not obvious is a case someone will 'fix' the day it fails.

cases.name: AI off: nothing is emitted
cases.why: A project that did not select AI chat must generate exactly what it always did — the absence of the block is the contract, not `enabled: false` (C57).

cases.name: A snapshot entity with insert and modify enabled
cases.why: The ordinary case: one readable entity, the two write paths that are on by default, and delete left out because it is not enabled.

cases.name: An over-long read is dropped with a warning, and no reference hint points at it
cases.why: FUI blocks the WHOLE assistant when one resource name is over 64 characters (its tool name is the name lowercased, and vendors cap tool names at 64), so a 61-character snapshot table must cost only its own read. The drop has to happen where the reads are built: they decide which references get a hint, and a hint that told the chat to copy a value from REQ_ of a table it cannot read would send it to a tool that does not exist. The 60-character table is the boundary — REQ_ plus 60 is exactly 64, and is kept.

eventHandler<Rfq>("EXECUTE_RFQ", transactional = true) {
    onValidate { event ->
      val details = event.details
      val rfqId = requireNotNull(details.rfqId) { "RFQ_ID is mandatory" }
      val existingRfq = entityDb.get(Rfq.ById(rfqId)) ?: return@onValidate nack("RFQ $rfqId not found")

        ?: return@onCommit nack("RFQ $rfqId has no price to execute at")

      existingRfq.status = Rfq.Status.EXECUTED
      existingRfq.lastUpdated = now()
      entityDb.modify(existingRfq)

      val today = now()
      val settlement = now().plusDays(2)

      val newTrade = Trade {
        this.rfqId = existingRfq.rfqId
        instrumentId = existingRfq.instrumentId
        clientCode = existingRfq.clientCode
        axeReference = existingRfq.axeReference
        direction = Trade.Direction.valueOf(existingRfq.direction.name)
        trader = existingRfq.trader
        salesPerson = existingRfq.salesperson
        tradedPrice = agreedPrice
        tradedQuantity = existingRfq.quantity
        tradeDate = today
        this.settlementDate = settlement
      }
      val insertedTrade = entityDb.insert(newTrade)

      ack(listOf(mapOf(
        "RFQ_ID" to existingRfq.rfqId,
        "TRADE_ID" to insertedTrade.record.tradeId,
      )))
    }
  }
